decision_rationale: The paper is an empirical study of post-training across >100 biological reasoning models, not a review or benchmark resource. It gives foundation-model-like evidence via multimodal biological pretraining and broad transfer across DNA, RNA, and proteins, but it does not explicitly state a generative mechanism such as decoder or autoregressive generation.
evidence_snippet: "combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins"; "we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models"; "continued pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL)"; "across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins"; "language models"; "post-training"; "OOD performance"; "aligning models with biological language"; "trained on multimodal biological data"; "broadly applicable" not stated explicitly but transferable across modalities is shown in evaluation
